# LegitGrails Academy

> > Professional luxury handbag authentication training platform offering certification courses for Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Dior, Hermès, Prada, and Saint Laurent.

LegitGrails Academy provides comprehensive authentication education for luxury fashion brands, with courses taught by experts including Claire Salmon, Xeena Morales, Maria Bellotto, and Alissa Chernova. The platform offers individual brand courses and multi-brand bundles for counterfeit detection and authentication certification.

## Key Topics

- Luxury handbag authentication
- Chanel authentication
- Louis Vuitton authentication
- Gucci authentication
- Dior authentication
- Hermès authentication
- Prada authentication
- Saint Laurent authentication
- Counterfeit detection
- Designer brand education
- Authentication certification
- Fashion authentication training
- Luxury brand verification
- Authentication experts
- Course bundles
